arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Because you've noticed a gassy smell, please treat this as a possible gas leak. Please don't use the oven or hob, and don't use any light switches, flames or electrical appliances near it. Open the windows if you can, leave the flat now, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). If anyone feels unwell or you are in immediate danger, call 999. Please don't go back in until the gas engineer says it's safe. We are arranging an urgent gas safety check and will treat the oven repair as part of it. Our target is same day / within 24 hours. We'll be in touch shortly.
